Vaṇīvilāsa Press, Śrīraṅgam
------------------------------------------
When Saccidānanda Śivābhinava Nṛsiṁha भारती (A.
-1912), the 33rd pontiff of the शारदा मठ of Śṛṅgerī, discovered कालडी (in Kerala State) as the birth-place of शङ्कर (A.

-820), he made all arrangements to acquire the land and develop a monastic centre there. It was his earnest desire that someone should take the responsi-bility of collecting all the works of शङ्कर and bring them out in print. This task was entrusted to T. K. बालसुब्रह्मण्य Aiyar (A.
-1947) who, with superhuman efforts started the Vāṇīvilāsa Press at श्रीरङ्गम् in A.

. After collecting thousands of manuscripts of शङ्कर’s works, he successfully brought out over the years, the entire series under the general title Śrī शङ्कर Granthāvaliḥ.
The books have been out of print for a long time.
They have now been reprinted by the Samata books of Chennai.
